description: Defines a field that can be used in a pivot table configuration.

members.name: FormatValue
members.description: Gets the formatted display value for a given raw value.

members.name: Accessor
members.description: Accessor function to extract the raw value from a data item.

members.name: Area
members.description: The current area where this field is placed.

members.name: DisplayFormatter
members.description: Optional formatter for displaying the field value.

members.name: HeaderClass
members.description: Optional CSS class applied to header cells for this field.

members.name: HeaderStyle
members.description: Optional inline style applied to header cells for this field.

members.name: SortBy
members.description: Sort criterion for this dimension field. Default: Value.

members.name: SortDirection
members.description: Sort direction applied to this dimension field. Default: None.

members.name: Title
members.description: Display title shown in the UI.
